steps.text: 08:30 A.M. \ Snowstorm
Northlands - Infy Ice Field - Rhine Lab Temporary Research Outpost #420

steps.name: Device
steps.text: System unlocked.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Year: Unknown

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Time and date error. Switching to manual control.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Authenticate identity to proceed.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hm, let's see here... Right. Rhine Lab Field Specialist, Magallan.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Authenticating——

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Authentication complete. Voice print confirmed.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Beep——

steps.name: Device
steps.text: Fingerprint confirmed.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: (lively feminine voice) Hi! How are you, Maggie? Welcome back!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Well that's weird.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I guess I shouldn't have let Mayer play with the sign-in system. What a weird function...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Welp, anyway, let's get to work!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: This is our last survey of the year. Let's make sure there's nothing new.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: By now, all regions marked for survey are done. Once they finish their other tasks, they'll start on the trip back.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Phew. Done.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I am really no good at writing reports. Let's hear the audio.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: (lively feminine voice) Hi , Maggie! Today is the one hundred, eighty, seventh day of your survey.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Wow, I've been out here a while. The time really flies.

steps.name: Device
steps.text: (lively feminine voice) You have been out so long, shouldn't you head back? Everyone misses you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh?! Was that in there before... Don't tell me Mayer snuck in some new parameters.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Well, it's a cute little surprise either way. How nice.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But, as for going back, I think...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: This snowstorm looks like it'll last at least a week. Good thing I've got plenty of supplies.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Let's take another look at the to do list. I think I remember a few things still need doing.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Let's see here. Right. Sample collection is done. Searching for clues in the ruins, I think we can call that done.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Nothing much new, compared to last year. If only we had a discovery like the year before.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It's pretty normal, but I bet the section chief still chews me out for getting greedy.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Nothing here either... Oh? Here's a blank. Low temperature test of new materials... oh.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I totally forgot!! Where did I put that new material?!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh crap! They're gonna kill me if I lose it!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Phew. That was close. I just left it in my outer pocket.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The outer pocket is 43 degrees below zero. I kept it there six hours. It retains elasticity.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Now to test hardness.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Well, no problem. Into the experiment chamber you go.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Thank goodness I put it in my jacket...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: With the blizzard and all, I guess I can just put it outside the door and see how it holds up in a low temperature environment.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I think the current temperature out there should be right.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay, Magallan. Here we go. Take a deep breath, open the door a split second, toss the thing out, then shut it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Gotta be quick, precise, decisive. Or else the snowstorm gets in here and we're all done.
Excuse me...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Magallan, did you just see a ghost?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yes, Magallan, and she was very pretty. Still a ghost though.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But how could there be another person up here in the Northlands?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: C- could it be some kind of snow ghost?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No way. I just have to open the door and take another look. I have to answer this question with science!!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: There's no such thing as ghosts! And I'm not so cold that I'm hallucinating!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What if it's some kind of uncontacted tribe? That would be huge! Go for it, Magallan!
Excuse me, can I come in?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Er... Um... You... I...
Don't be afraid. I am not a ghost. Here, touch my face.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh? What?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, okay...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Wow. You're warm! But how? How are you here in the Northlands?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...are you a Sami?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ah...
I don't know why that seems disappointing to you, but I am indeed a Sami. Nice to meet you, little girl.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: H- hi. I still don't know how you got here, but please come in. A normal person would freeze to death out there.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I mean, wouldn't a blizzard like this be a problem even for a Sami?
Thank you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Here, have some tea.
Thank you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What's your name?
You may call me——
Let's say Simone. Simone. And your name, little girl?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: My codename is Magallan! Rhine Lab Field Specialist, assigned to Research Outpost #420...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It's only me here, at the moment.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone, why are you here? Did you get caught in the storm...?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I was entrusted with the search for a certain individual.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Search? In the Northlands? There's no one here. For all the months I've been, I've seen maybe a couple living organisms.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: The client informed me that she would be active in this area.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Why are you looking for her?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: This storm will last for some time, which should delay her movements. I came here to retrieve her.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, really? Do you mean me?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I am not certain.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: R- right. So you're not here for me. But the weather as it is, it really doesn't bother you?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: The Sami... rather, I am familiar with snow.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: But if the weather continues to deteriorate, many things will change in unpredictable ways.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yeah. I knew this storm would last a while, but I didn't think it would be this intense.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I wanted to wait for the wind to die down a bit... We would have to speed things up like this.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: According to the calendar and my observations, tomorrow would be the best time!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And we have enough supplies. I really did well.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: All these supplies are for you alone?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, no. These are for all the people living at this research station to hold out until next year's survey season.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: If you need to live here for a while, you can use these supplies too.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But you can't touch my equipment!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Oh. Okay.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Good, well, now that that's decided, let's get packing!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Sorry, Simone, there's a few things I have to prepare.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Sure. No problem. I won't get in the way.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Suitcase, suitcase, where did I put my suitcase? Oh, I remember. I brought it down from the loft and put it in the kitchen!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The survey apparatus, and the drone... Meh, it's fine.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Just need to charge a bit.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh? Oh, no. I can take care of all of this myself.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I've been doing this all by myself for a while. I got lots of practice.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: So this is where you work?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That's right. I do research and observation.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: What do you observe?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: All the ice fields of the Northlands!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: And you're the only one here?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yep. That's my job.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You don't get lonely?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I do! But I don't think loneliness and happiness are mutually exclusive.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I know my colleagues are all waiting for me to come back. And I know these ice fields hold so many amazing secrets waiting to be unlocked. So it's not that bad.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Sometimes I get lonely. But most of the time, I'm really very happy!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: To be alone... is very scary. A life like this... I don't even know what to say.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I know it's not for everyone.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Being an explorer isn't easy!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Err, ahem, being a scientist!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You are... truly optimistic.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hehe. To borrow the words of one of the greats: 'An explorer's best friend is loneliness!'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, but the section chief said I have this bad habit of talking to myself. Do I? I don't think I do?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: It's fine, Miss Magallan. You are a fine person.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh. Huh. Heh. Really?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay, the station's energy reserves should hold up all right, as long as I set the hibernation times right. So...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Right. Like I said, aside from the research equipment, you're free to use anything you want, Simone.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I see. Thank you.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: But I am Infected. Is it okay for us to share supplies? To share this facility?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You noticed, didn't you, Magallan?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Er, yes. I noticed. You certainly didn't do anything to hide it.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You are not afraid?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It surprised me a bit at first glance... it did! You don't usually see crystal distributions like this...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But really, as pretty as you are, Simone, those crystals look even more special.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You need not avoid my eyes.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, your eyes... huh? You should really get treatment, Simone. It's a little dangerous there.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: That is not what I mean. My meaning is, do you not fear infection?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh. No, I don't need to worry about that. Rhine Lab's research has proven time and again that Oripathy transmission from person to person is not nearly as easy as most people think.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Even though nobody seems to listen... Sigh.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I have lots of Infected friends and colleagues. It's no big deal.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: ...Really?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yep. Really. Everyone at Rhine Lab Medical is really proud of what we've accomplished!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But when it comes to Infected stuff, we can't compare to a pharmaceutical company called 'Rhodes Island...'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It pisses off some of my colleagues, but it's the truth. They do really amazing work on Oripathy over there.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That's why Rhine Lab signed a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island. I'm actually going there myself!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm pretty excited. I have no idea what it's like, but I really hope I can get some really good research done! I thought I'd be cooped up in a lab forever...

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You really like to talk, don't you?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Obviously! I really like talking to other people. But, um, if I start to talk your ear off, you can just tell me. I'll quiet down...

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Not at all. I like you talking about all these things I don't know.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh. Huh. I'm blushing a little...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You know, Simone, you could go to Rhodes Island for treatment! Hey, I could even take you there!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You aren't worried that I have some ulterior motive?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ulterior motive?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: That I am bad.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay, Simone, are you bad then?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: ...Yes. Am I bad then.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Magallan, do you feel like the temperature is dropping?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The temperature? Huh, now that you mention it, it is a bit colder than it was before... Hold on... Oh no...
Warning, anomaly detected in climate control center, outer heating function will be disabled.
Warning...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That's not good. Excuse me a second, I need to check on that control system.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Uh oh. Exterior heating pipes sprung a leak. Probably just worn out...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Sorry, Simone, I have to step outside for a bit.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: What is going to happen?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: If I let the system go ahead and shut down the outer heat shell, the outpost isn't going to make it to next season. Or at least, it won't be able to support life.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: How many days do we have?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Two months, give or take... No matter how familiar you are with snow, you wouldn't be able to live here.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I won't. I am leaving the Northlands soon.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Is that right.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: ...are you still packing?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm getting ready to go out there.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Did you not just say it could last two months?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yeah, that's no good! It's gotta make it to next season!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: It is not safe to be out there in that storm. Such a harsh environment may endanger your life. Don't go.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No can do. This outpost isn't just for me. It's a base of operations, and it needs to hold up for good.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: No one else is coming in this weather.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone, you just showed up in this weather like ten minutes ago.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I am different. I am not an explorer, Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Phew... this heater is heavy...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: This outpost is even more important.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: For an explorer, base camps like this outpost are lifesaving nodes. If this outpost goes down, an explorer who runs out of supplies or gets lost might come here and find only death.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Okay, but, since the time it was built, up until I got here, has anyone else come by?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Not a one.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Then what does it matter?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It matters.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: How are you so sure?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Because there will be someone coming by. Maybe not tomorrow, maybe not until the next research season, maybe not for another couple of years.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: You are just making baseless assumptions. Magallan, it is dangerous out there.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: No one is coming. At least not until the dry season. No explorer is coming.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone... You said you're not an explorer, didn't you?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: That is correct.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Well, different explorers make different choices.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Some of them might choose to come here when it's nice and calm, to explore the length and breadth of the Northlands. No one's done it yet, but people are always trying.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And some of them might come here at its most dangerous, to see how the land shapes and changes, to record what they see and bring it back to civilization.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The Black Flow of Bolívar, the highland plains of Kazimierz, the undersea volcanoes of Iberia... there was a time when no one had seen them either.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But now the explorers have been and gone, planted their flags.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And there are still many places in the world no one has set foot on yet. But that's all it means. Not yet.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Today, I set foot on this ice field. That means more people will come in the future.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And we have no idea under what circumstances they'll be coming.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: And if no one else comes in your lifetime?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: After you go back, won't this station fall into ruin?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I can't give up. There's always that minute chance that some nonexistant explorer might come along two months later.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone... You have to understand. I, Magallan, believe in exploration. I believe in explorers.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: One day, our footprints will cover this entire land.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: ...You have put your hopes in a future that may not come to pass. Will you not be disappointed?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No big deal. An explorer spends her whole life discovering, and her whole life being disappointed.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No explorer's discovery is purely her own. Every one of us stands on the shoulders of all the explorers who came before us. Every discovery is connected to a long and storied past.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Like, I'm only here in this ice field because of a story I heard as a child.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But I know in my heart that even if the thing I'm looking for doesn't exist, everything I do still has meaning.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Even if it's just some empty, disappointing, imaginary meaning.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oof, this heater is a little too powerful... burned my hair last time. Oh well, on you go!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yep! Welp, here I go!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Let me go in your stead.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone, you came here looking for someone, right? Our outpost here doesn't hire anybody!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I already found her.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You mean me, Magallan?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: The environment has deteriorated to the point where our messenger was unable to inform you in advance.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Allow me to reintroduce myself. I am a Rhodes Island Operator, codename 'Santalla.' I am here to retrieve you. Of course, you can keep calling me Simone.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Let me go in your stead.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Nope. It's too risky!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: That's what I should be saying to you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Nope nope nope. I'm the field specialist here. It's my responsibility.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Don't underestimate me.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Tell me how to do the repair, Operator Magallan. And let me take care of everything outside.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay, okay, I got it. Here, take this!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Just press this button and I'll come out and get you! And take this, and this...

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Heh heh, thank you...

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: I truly found the right person. I don't need them, Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You do! I can't let you go out there without...

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: No. Operator Magallan... trust me.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: The land, she trusts me too.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: We spend our whole lives discovering, and our whole lives being disappointed. Right?
Foolish Sami. What will this resistance accomplish?
You are indeed impressive. We cannot escape this storm.
But what does it matter? Ursus will crush you, swallow your cities, devour your land!
Witch... we will not kill you.
We will die, but you will live. You must live. You must see the land stained with blood!
Take this. A gift from the dead! Take it, with your eye!
Scream! Cry! Then live!
We die in glory! You live in ignominy! Forever!!
Witch!

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Indeed. How was it I always felt this world would die?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: So long as there are children like this, the world will find a way to flourish.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Rest assured, Magallan. There are some things that are beyond you. Let the adults handle it. It is good for us too.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: '...Listen ♪...'

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: '...Flourishing life blooming white, buried black seeds deep in the night... ♪'

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: 'Sing out, pretty girl. Cry out, pretty girl ♪'

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: 'The snow hears your song, the blizzard keeps you warm ♪'

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: ——Snows of the Northlands, do you hear my song?

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: Magallan... I want you to follow your dreams.

steps.name: Simone
steps.text: There. That should stop the snow.
